summary: Task chips dragged from a tray onto weekday drop zones, with a dashed highlight while a chip is over a day.
use: Scheduling, assigning and filing: any place a loose item is dropped onto a target that is not a sortable list.
spec: Each chip is `{@attach dnd.draggable(() => ({ id: t.id, label: t.title }))}` on an element with `data-dnd-item`
Each day is `{@attach dnd.dropzone(() => ({ id: day, label: day, onDrop: (e) => drop(day, e) }))}`; the zone is outlined while a chip is over it
Keyboard: Space lifts a chip, the arrows pick the day, Enter drops; the zone name is announced to screen readers
